from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import time

root = Path.home() / ".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
runtime = root / "models"
db_path = runtime / "runtime.sqlite"
task_id = "A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-20261006-R2"
result = root / "model_results" / (task_id + ".json")
retry_at = 0.0
if db_path.is_file() and not db_path.is_symlink():
    db = sqlite3.connect("file:" + str(db_path) + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:

    raise SystemExit(10)

    time.sleep(wait)

print("SOL_R2_RESULT_PRESENT=" + ("1" if present else "0") + " NO_DUPLICATE_MODEL_RESUME=1 RETRY_AT=" + str(retry_at))
